messages:
Alex K: Uploading the third‑party pen test artifacts and initial triage notes. Bundle here: https://redwood-secure.s3.amazonaws.com/pt/1838452100/evidence.zip. High-level: auth session fixation (CVSS 7.2), outdated dependency in embed-worker (CVSS 6.5), and a permissive S3 ACL on an internal bucket (low).
Maria G: thanks — sending to customer security review queue. Do we have proof-of-fix timelines? they asked for "remediation ETA + verification steps" for their vendor risk team.
Danielle R: I can take the embed-worker dependency. Repro + diff attached in the bundle. Plan: bump dependency, run integration tests, create canary deploy. ETA 72h. I'll open PR and tag @Sam D for perf check.
Sam D: ack. I'll run perf on dedicated and hosted staging, watch memory + p95 latency. If canary looks good I'll approve for canary rollout. Need the exact commit SHA when PR is open.
SecOps Bot: Automated vuln scan (2026-03-21T09:12:03Z) completed for commit 1f3c... Report: 2 high, 3 medium, 4 low. Scan artifacts stored at s3://redwood-secops-scans/1838452100/scan-report.html
Alex K: For the auth session issue — it's a logic flow on cookie rotation during SSO token refresh. @Danielle R and @Sam D can you estimate verification steps? Customer will want test cases.
Danielle R: For auth fix: add rotation check, unit test + end-to-end with mocked SSO provider. Verification steps I'll paste here: 1) run ./scripts/ssotest --rotate 2) confirm session id changes and previous token invalidated 3) check logs for 401->200 flow.
Jordan P: Customer timeline: they want remediation evidence by EOB Friday for legal sign-off. Can we commit to retest window? If engineering needs more time we push their SLA date — prefer not.
Danielle R: ETA 72h for embed dependency, auth rotation likely 48h with a focused patch. S3 ACL fix is trivial (remove public grants), I can do that now and push.
Maria G: I'll coordinate the vendor risk reviewer. Once you have commits, upload screenshots and test logs to the evidence folder and ping me. They also require a signed test plan and CVSS mapping per item.
Sam D: FYI when you open the embed PR include perf test script: `python perf/run_batch.py --model=longform --concurrency=8 --duration=300` so I can reproduce. Also record p50/p95 before/after.
Alex K: Noted. Danielle, can you post the PR link + commit SHA here when ready? Also include a short remediation summary per CVE/issue for the customer.
Danielle R: Will do. Quick note: for the auth issue CVSS 7.2, mitigation includes session invalidation and adding rotating cookie salt. I'll paste the snippet in PR description.
SecOps Bot: Vulnerability ticket created #VULN-183845 with links to evidence and assigned to Danielle R.
Jordan P: Scheduling retest with third-party: tentative slot Mon 2026-04-05 14:00 UTC. If we need earlier internal retest please call it out.
Alex K: Ok let's aim for internal retest by Fri EOD so we can handoff to third‑party for verification. @Maria G please update the customer that we're targeting Friday internal retest and Monday verification window. :thumbsup:
Maria G: Will do, sending them a short note now and copying legal/Sec.
Sam D: small heads-up — if the dependency bump triggers quantization regression on dedicated, I'll escalate and propose a rollback plan. Keep an eye on eval metrics.
Alex K: Good catch. Add eval prompt set to the PR so we can block on regressions.
Danielle R: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1248 commit 1f3c9a. Bumped dependency, added tests, removed S3 public ACL. Test logs uploaded to evidence folder.
Maria G: got the PR and logs. forwarding to customer's risk reviewer now.
Alex K: Thanks team — please paste final verification screenshots and mark this thread when ready for retest. I'll compile a short remediation summary for the customer packet.
Jordan P: I'll update the deal tracker once customer confirms.
Maria G: Customer replied: "Thanks — we'll review and aim to start verification Monday." Closing loop here after their confirmation. :white_check_mark:
